record_title: Asymmetric counterexamples for balanced-tripartite triangle counts
limitations: This is an upper-bound construction and does not determine f(n,t). The optimality statement is only within the two-parameter construction family and does not exclude different counterexamples at smaller n. The bipartite gadget and symmetric special case are prior work. The source preprint is very recent, so unindexed parallel work or a later revision remains a residual originality risk. Finite verification supports but does not replace the symbolic proof. No independent validation is asserted.
